title: ChatGPT vs Claude: Free vs Paid, Coding, Writing and Pricing Guide
metaDescription: Compare ChatGPT and Claude across free and paid plans ($20/mo), writing, coding (Codex vs Claude Code, Artifacts, code blocks), document analysis, privacy, and APIs.
introSummary: ChatGPT and Claude both offer free tiers, $20/month flagship personal plans ($20 USD / £20 GBP incl. VAT in UK for ChatGPT Plus; $20 USD monthly or $17 USD/mo billed annually at $200 for Claude Pro), high-capacity plans ($200/mo ChatGPT Pro; $100/mo Claude Max and $200/mo Claude Ultra/Max), team/enterprise workspaces (starting at 2 seats), and token-billed developer APIs. Neither assistant is a universal winner: ChatGPT is an all-in-one multimodal workspace with live web search, Advanced Voice Mode, native ChatGPT Images generation, and sandboxed Python data analysis, whereas Claude specialises in natural long-form writing, model-dependent context windows up to 1M tokens, live UI rendering in Artifacts, and terminal-based coding with Claude Code.

quickAnswer.text: Choose ChatGPT if you want one multimodal workspace combining live web search, Advanced Voice Mode, native ChatGPT Images creation, sandboxed Python spreadsheet analysis, OpenAI Codex for terminal/IDE coding, and interactive writing and code blocks.
quickAnswer.label: Editorial recommendation · Sourced

quickAnswer.text: Choose Claude if your priority is nuanced long-form writing, analysing lengthy contracts or codebases in a model-dependent context window of up to 1M tokens, previewing interactive UI components in Artifacts, or running agentic terminal workflows with Claude Code.
quickAnswer.label: Editorial recommendation · Sourced

quickAnswer.text: Personal plans start at $0 (Free) and $20 USD/mo on flagship tiers: ChatGPT Plus costs $20 USD/mo (£20 GBP/mo incl. VAT on UK web checkout; ChatGPT Go is $8 USD/mo where available), while Claude Pro costs $20 USD/mo monthly or $17 USD/mo billed annually ($200 upfront, plus applicable local tax/VAT). High-capacity tiers scale to Claude Max ($100/mo 5x) and Ultra/Max ($200/mo) and ChatGPT Pro ($200/mo).
quickAnswer.label: Official source fact

quickAnswer.text: Apps, business workspaces, and APIs are separate products: ChatGPT Business Standard ($20 USD/user/mo billed annually or $25 monthly, minimum 2 seats) and Claude Team (minimum 2 seats, 2-150 total; Standard seat at $20 USD/seat/mo annual or $25 monthly and Premium seat at $100 annual or $125 monthly, with both seat types including Claude Code) do not train models on company data by default, and developer APIs (OpenAI Platform API and Anthropic API) are billed per token.
quickAnswer.label: Official source fact

keyDifferences.description: Claude is widely used for structured long-form drafting, custom writing Styles, and multi-document synthesis alongside web search and Research mode. ChatGPT pairs interactive inline writing blocks and side-by-side editing with ChatGPT Search and multi-step Deep Research reports.

keyDifferences.topic: Coding & Software Development (OpenAI Codex vs Claude Code & Artifacts)
keyDifferences.description: Both platforms offer terminal coding agents and in-app code workspaces: Claude includes Claude Code (across Pro, Max, Ultra, Team Standard & Premium seats, Enterprise, and API) alongside live browser Artifacts for React/HTML previews. OpenAI provides Codex (including the open-source Codex CLI for terminal repository coding, IDE extensions for VS Code/Cursor, and desktop integration) authenticated with ChatGPT subscription accounts (Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise) or API keys, alongside interactive code blocks and sandboxed Python data execution.

Claude supports model-dependent context windows up to 1M tokens across Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise, and API tiers (with 1M tokens on current flagship models and 200K tokens on select variants) for analysing full contracts, financial filings, and multi-file Projects. ChatGPT combines persistent Projects with Advanced Data Analysis, executing Python directly on uploaded CSV and Excel files to clean data and plot charts.

ChatGPT is a broader multimodal generation suite featuring Advanced Voice Mode for spoken dialogue and native ChatGPT Images creation and editing. Claude analyses uploaded images, charts, and PDFs and renders interactive SVG/HTML diagrams via Artifacts, but does not generate photorealistic raster images.

keyDifferences.topic: Pricing, Plan Tiers & Currency Billing (USD & GBP)
keyDifferences.description: Both start at $0 on Free and $20 USD/mo on flagship monthly plans. OpenAI offers ChatGPT Go ($8 USD/mo where available), ChatGPT Plus ($20 USD/mo; £20 GBP/mo incl. VAT in UK), and ChatGPT Pro ($200 USD/mo; £200 GBP/mo). Anthropic offers an annual discount on Claude Pro ($17 USD/mo billed annually at $200, or $20/mo monthly) and two high-capacity tiers: Claude Max 5x ($100 USD/mo) and Max 20x ($200 USD/mo).

keyDifferences.topic: Privacy, Data Handling & Model Training Defaults
keyDifferences.description: On commercial and API tiers (ChatGPT Business, ChatGPT Enterprise, OpenAI API, Claude Team, Claude Enterprise, and Anthropic API), neither provider trains generative models on customer data by default. On consumer plans (ChatGPT Free/Go/Plus/Pro and Claude Free/Pro/Max), chats and coding sessions may be used for model improvement unless you opt out in your privacy settings.

Standard $20/month consumer subscriptions (ChatGPT Plus and Claude Pro) do not fund general developer API calls, which are billed per token (though Claude Max $100/$200 plans include monthly Claude Platform API credit allotments under Anthropic's current terms).

faqCandidates.question: Is ChatGPT or Claude better on the free plan?
faqCandidates.answer: Both free plans ($0 / £0) handle everyday drafting, coding questions, and web search. Claude Free includes access to Claude Sonnet and Haiku (with model-dependent context windows up to 1M tokens), Artifacts previews, and up to 5 Projects, but enforces rolling 5-hour session caps and excludes Claude Opus and Claude Code. ChatGPT Free includes ChatGPT Search, standard voice, Custom GPT access, and limited ChatGPT Images generation.

faqCandidates.question: How do ChatGPT Plus, ChatGPT Pro, Claude Pro, and Claude Max pricing compare?
faqCandidates.answer: On flagship monthly plans, both cost $20 USD/month: ChatGPT Plus is $20 USD/month (£20 GBP/month incl. VAT on UK web checkout), while Claude Pro is $20 USD/month monthly or $17 USD/month billed annually ($200 upfront, plus applicable local tax/VAT). For heavy individual users, Claude offers a $100 USD/month middle tier (Claude Max 5x) as well as a $200 USD/month tier (Claude Ultra/Max), whereas OpenAI steps from ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) directly to ChatGPT Pro ($200 USD/mo; £200 GBP/mo).

faqCandidates.question: Which is better for coding and software development: ChatGPT or Claude?
faqCandidates.answer: Both provide advanced coding workflows across consumer apps and developer tools. Claude features Artifacts for live React, HTML/CSS, and SVG rendering directly in the browser, plus Claude Code (included with Claude Pro, Max, Ultra, Team Standard and Premium seats, Enterprise, and API) for terminal-based agentic workflows across local repositories. ChatGPT provides OpenAI Codex (including the open-source Codex CLI for terminal repository coding and IDE extensions for VS Code and Cursor, authenticated with ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, or API keys), interactive in-chat code blocks with live previews, and a sandboxed Python environment for data science and file automation.

faqCandidates.question: Which is better for long-form writing, editing, and document analysis?
faqCandidates.answer: Claude is frequently chosen for long-form writing and document review because its model-dependent context window (up to 1M tokens on current models, 200K on select variants) handles full contracts, transcripts, and book-length PDFs in a single prompt while maintaining a natural, low-fluff prose style. ChatGPT is strong when your writing workflow depends on interactive in-chat writing blocks with targeted paragraph feedback or combining uploaded documents with Python data tables.

faqCandidates.question: How do ChatGPT Business and Claude Team compare for company use?
faqCandidates.answer: Both team plans require a minimum of 2 seats and start at $20 USD/seat/month billed annually or $25 USD/seat/month billed monthly (ChatGPT Business Standard for 2+ seats; Claude Team Standard for 2-150 seats). Both Standard and Premium seats on Claude Team include Claude Code, and organisations can mix Standard seats ($20-$25/mo) with high-capacity Premium seats ($100 USD/seat/mo annual or $125 monthly, providing 5x more usage for intensive coding), whereas ChatGPT Business focuses on shared Projects, Custom GPTs, and connectors.

faqCandidates.question: How do ChatGPT and Claude handle data privacy and AI model training?
faqCandidates.answer: Both providers separate consumer and commercial data policies. On commercial workspaces and developer APIs (ChatGPT Business, ChatGPT Enterprise, OpenAI API, Claude Team, Claude Enterprise, and Anthropic API), neither company trains generative models on customer inputs or outputs by default. On consumer plans (ChatGPT Free/Go/Plus/Pro and Claude Free/Pro/Max/Ultra), conversations and coding sessions may be used for model training unless you turn off model improvement in your privacy settings.

faqCandidates.question: Why does the catalogue table list API available as No for both ChatGPT and Claude?

Both companies offer full developer APIs billed per million tokens, and standard $20/month consumer subscriptions (ChatGPT Plus and Claude Pro) do not pay for general API calls—though Claude Max ($100/mo), Ultra ($200/mo), and Team plans include monthly Claude Platform API credit allotments under Anthropic's current terms.

title: ChatGPT vs Google Gemini: Free vs Paid, Workflows and Pricing
metaDescription: Compare ChatGPT and Google Gemini across free and paid plans ($20/mo), Google Workspace integration, coding, research, voice, APIs, and daily workflows.
introSummary: ChatGPT and Google Gemini both offer free tiers, low-cost entry plans, ~$20/month flagship personal plans ($20 USD / £20 GBP for ChatGPT Plus; $19.99 USD / £18.99 GBP for Google AI Pro), business workspaces, and separately billed developer APIs. Neither assistant is a universal winner: ChatGPT is built as a standalone workspace for coding, Python data analysis, Canvas editing, and Projects, whereas Google Gemini connects directly into Gmail, Docs, Drive, Sheets, Slides, and Meet and bundles Google One storage on consumer plans.

quickAnswer.text: Choose ChatGPT if you want a standalone workspace for writing and coding in Canvas, sandboxed Python spreadsheet analysis, persistent Projects, and native ChatGPT Images generation.
quickAnswer.label: Editorial recommendation · Sourced

quickAnswer.text: Choose Google Gemini if your daily work lives in Gmail, Google Docs, Drive, Sheets, Slides, and Meet and you want native side-panel assistance across your Google account.
quickAnswer.label: Editorial recommendation · Sourced

quickAnswer.text: Personal plans span Free ($0 / £0), lightweight entry tiers where available (ChatGPT Go at $8 USD/mo; Google AI Plus at $4.99 USD/mo), and flagship plans at $20 USD/mo (£20 GBP/mo in UK) for ChatGPT Plus versus $19.99 USD/mo (£18.99 GBP/mo in UK) for Google AI Pro with Google One cloud storage.
quickAnswer.label: Official source fact

quickAnswer.text: Apps, business workspaces, and APIs are billed separately: ChatGPT Business (formerly Team, $20 USD/user/mo annual or $25 monthly) and Google Workspace ($7-$22+ USD / £5.90-£18+ GBP per user/mo annual ex. VAT) cover team governance, while OpenAI Platform API and Google AI Studio / Vertex AI charge per token.
quickAnswer.label: Official source fact

keyDifferences.description: Google Gemini connects natively to Gmail, Google Docs, Drive, Sheets, Slides, and Meet via Workspace extensions and side panels. ChatGPT operates as a standalone workspace with Projects, Custom GPTs, Canvas, and cloud file connectors.

Both offer a free tier and lightweight entry plans in eligible regions (ChatGPT Go at $8 USD/mo; Google AI Plus at $4.99 USD/mo or £4.49 GBP/mo in UK with 400 GB storage). Standard personal plans cost $20 USD/mo (£20 GBP/mo incl. VAT in UK) for ChatGPT Plus and $19.99 USD/mo (£18.99 GBP/mo in UK) for Google AI Pro (Gemini Advanced), which bundles 5 TB of Google One storage.

keyDifferences.topic: Product Scope: Apps, Models, Business Plans & APIs
keyDifferences.description: Both providers separate consumer apps (chatgpt.com, gemini.google.com), underlying model families, business plans (ChatGPT Business, formerly Team, vs Google Workspace with Gemini), and token-billed developer APIs (OpenAI Platform API vs Google AI Studio and Vertex AI).

Both support live web search and multi-step Deep Research reports. Gemini cross-references web findings directly against files in your Google Drive, whereas ChatGPT pairs web search with uploaded files and Python data execution inside Projects.

ChatGPT includes an interactive Canvas editor for side-by-side writing and code revisions plus sandboxed Python execution (Advanced Data Analysis) for spreadsheets and charts. Gemini offers Gemini Canvas, one-click export to Google Docs, Sheets, and Google Colab, and large-context document review.

ChatGPT features Advanced Voice Mode for spoken dialogue and native image generation and editing via ChatGPT Images. Gemini offers Gemini Live for conversational voice alongside Imagen-powered image generation and multimodal file inputs.

tableFootnote: Catalogue note: In the table above, ChatGPT lists API available as No because WhichAIPick tracks the consumer ChatGPT application (/tools/chatgpt/) separately from the developer OpenAI API (/tools/openai-api/), whereas the Google Gemini catalogue entry (/tools/google-gemini/) records Google's developer API availability alongside the assistant. Consumer subscriptions ($20/month) do not include API usage credits on either platform.

faqCandidates.question: Is ChatGPT or Google Gemini better on the free plan?
faqCandidates.answer: Both free plans ($0 / £0) cover everyday writing, web search, voice chat, and image prompts. Choose Gemini Free if you use Gmail, Docs, and Drive daily and want fast Google Search grounding; choose ChatGPT Free if you prefer a standalone workspace with Custom GPTs, Canvas editing, and ChatGPT Search.

faqCandidates.question: How do ChatGPT and Google Gemini paid plans compare in USD and GBP?
faqCandidates.answer: Both offer lightweight entry plans in eligible regions (ChatGPT Go at $8 USD/mo; Google AI Plus at $4.99 USD/mo or £4.49 GBP/mo in UK with 400 GB storage). Their flagship individual plans cost $20 USD/month (£20 GBP/month incl. VAT on UK web checkout) for ChatGPT Plus and $19.99 USD/month (£18.99 GBP/month in the UK) for Google AI Pro, which also bundles 5 TB of Google One storage. High-capacity plans scale to $200 USD/mo (£200 GBP/mo) on ChatGPT Pro and $99.99-$249.99 USD/mo on Google AI Ultra.

faqCandidates.question: Which assistant integrates natively with Google Workspace (Docs, Gmail, Drive, Sheets)?
faqCandidates.answer: Google Gemini integrates natively across Google Workspace. On Google AI Pro and Google Workspace Business Standard ($14 USD / £11.80 GBP per user/month annual ex. VAT) or higher, Gemini appears directly inside Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, and Meet side panels (whereas Business Starter at $7 USD / £5.90 GBP includes the Gemini app and Gmail writing help). ChatGPT can read Drive files via connectors, but does not run inside Google Workspace editors.

faqCandidates.question: Why does the catalogue table list API available as No for ChatGPT and Yes for Google Gemini?
faqCandidates.answer: WhichAIPick catalogues the consumer ChatGPT app (/tools/chatgpt/) separately from OpenAI's developer platform (/tools/openai-api/), whereas the Google Gemini entry (/tools/google-gemini/) records both the assistant and Google's developer API availability. Both companies provide full developer APIs (OpenAI Platform API and Google AI Studio / Vertex AI), and neither includes API token credits inside a consumer subscription.

faqCandidates.question: Which is better for coding and spreadsheet data analysis: ChatGPT or Gemini?
faqCandidates.answer: ChatGPT suits interactive coding and spreadsheet analysis because Canvas supports side-by-side code revisions and Advanced Data Analysis runs Python in a sandbox to clean CSV/Excel files and generate charts. Google Gemini suits large-context multi-file code review, one-click Python export to Google Colab, and direct table export into Google Sheets.

faqCandidates.question: Can I use ChatGPT or Google Gemini for HR, operations, and team workflows?
faqCandidates.answer: Yes. Organisations on Google Workspace Business Standard ($14 USD / £11.80 GBP user/mo annual) or Plus ($22 USD user/mo) often use Gemini to summarise Google Meet interviews, draft Gmail replies, and search HR policies in Drive. Standalone teams often use ChatGPT Business (formerly Team, $20 USD/user/mo annual or $25 monthly, 2+ seats) to share Projects and Custom GPTs for onboarding and policy Q&A.

faqCandidates.question: Do ChatGPT and Google Gemini train on my business or workspace data?
faqCandidates.answer: On business, enterprise, and API tiers (ChatGPT Business, ChatGPT Enterprise, OpenAI API, and Google Workspace Business/Enterprise with Gemini), both providers state in their official terms that customer prompts and workspace files are not used to train public models. On consumer Free and personal paid plans, chat history may be used to improve models unless you disable training in your account settings.
